meta.title: Translate — Open Bible Stories
meta.description: 7 steps to translating Open Bible Stories into your language.

hero.eyebrow: Help bring the Gospel to another language
hero.title: How to translate Open Bible Stories
hero.sub: Help make the Gospel available in another language. Follow the steps below to start a new translation based on unfoldingWord® Open Bible Stories.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.body:
To prepare to translate, begin by installing Scribe SE. For information on using Scribe SE, you may visit the Scribe SE docs.

Access translation resources on the Bible Well app.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body:
Study the foundational principles you need for translation.

Study "The Creation" in Scribe SE to become familiar with the story in the resource language.

steps.title: Translate
steps.body:
In Scribe SE:

  • Open the Open Bible Story you want to translate
  • Follow the steps on how to translate with your team to complete the drafting process

steps.title: Check internally
steps.body: Complete the steps for checking to perform partner and team checks.

steps.title: Check externally
steps.body:
• Follow the steps on this page to perform external checks
  • For more on checking, click here

steps.title: Publish
steps.body:
Once all stages of checking the translation have occurred, make final edits to the stories in Scribe SE and publish to Door43.

Follow this checklist to determine that the stories are ready to publish.

steps.title: Distribute
steps.body: You can share your Open Bible Stories translation in a variety of formats for evangelism and discipleship — or see the Create page for the underlying source files.

celebrate.title: Celebrate
celebrate.body: Take time to rejoice that you have Open Bible Stories in your language. Share the good news with everyone and give praise to God for what He has done.

resources.eyebrow: Equip others to understand and teach the Gospel
resources.title: Resources
resources.body: Translation Notes, Translation Questions, Study Notes, Study Questions, and the Extended (Theological Formation) edition — search your language once to see everything available for it. Looking for the stories themselves? That's Discover.
resources.searchPlaceholder: Search by language name, e.g. Swahili

finalCta.title: Need translation tools?
finalCta.body: Scribe SE and other editors for starting a translation are listed on the Create page.
